steps.name: Restart affected runtime service if approved

preflight_checks: Connector health check passes or fallback diagnostic captures failure
Prometheus still reports the service as unavailable
Human approval is present before restart, scale, or rollback

database._comment: Reference/documentation only - not read by common/database.py:create_engine. The actual pool is configured via DB_POOL_SIZE/DB_MAX_OVERFLOW env vars (common/config.py).

principles: Application services are stateless and connect to shared platform endpoints.
External application connectors use named profiles with explicit auth, secret, timeout, retry, and allowed operation contracts.
Secrets are referenced by secret_ref and injected by the runtime secret provider; secret values are not stored in this file.
Every external action must pass connector allowed_operations, policy, approval, audit, and post-check gates.

recovery_strategy.rationale: A bare process restart has no inverse action under a platform without deployment history (e.g. docker-compose); recovery is independent post-restart health validation plus operator escalation on failure, not a fabricated rollback.
